provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Original guide sources remain in its metadata.

nameChecks.ja: 最後の恐怖を飛ばしてやろう！

lead.text: Stop Starbuck's attacks early and prepare for Ahab's orders. Assign a Sinner to take Prey Mark and others to deplete the Assist Barrier.

listLead.text: Fight 3 enemies. Stop the main attacker early and prepare for the commander's orders. Assign a defender to take Prey Mark and attackers to deplete the Assist Barrier.

priorities.0.text: Stagger or defeat Starbuck first to reduce enemy attacks.

priorities.1.text: Let a Pierce-resistant Sinner face Track Them to the End!, preparing for focused attacks next turn.

priorities.2.text: During Assist Defense, deplete Queequeg's Shield rather than forcing Clashes with Ahab.

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Assist Defense redirects your attacks to Queequeg. This is intended. Keep the marked defender alive and deplete the Shield, or Stagger Ahab on the order turn to cancel it.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: One Sinner takes every attack and falls

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Check for Prey Mark. It also increases damage taken by 50%, so redirect the mark-applying attack to a durable Sinner beforehand. Ishmael's survival condition from Ricardo's fight does not apply here.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Ahab fully heals after you damage her

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: In the first half, falling below 50% HP or completing the specified action pattern triggers the second half and healing. Stopping Starbuck first is easier to manage than spending all damage on Ahab immediately.

units.0.hp.text: 610 → heals to 645 in the second half

units.0.stagger.text: 60% / 30% Part HP (366 / 183 in the first half)

units.0.notes.0.text: The 3-person encounter on Floor 3 of the Canto V dungeon. Separate from the final E.G.O fight and Refraction Railway versions.

units.0.notes.1.text: Cannot be defeated in the first half. Below 50% HP or after action pattern 5 ends, transitions to the second half, removing her buffs, debuffs, and Stagger while restoring overall and Part HP.

units.0.notes.2.text: Overall Max HP becomes 645 during the transition, but Part Max HP does not change.

units.0.notes.3.text: Defeating Ahab also defeats the other 2 enemies and wins the battle.

units.1.notes.0.text: A durable defender who intercepts attacks aimed at Ahab. Once per battle at 0 HP, recovers to 50% of Max HP.

units.1.notes.1.text: Assist Defense does not function while Staggered. In the second half, depleting the Shield alone no longer causes Stagger; aim for normal Stagger Thresholds.

units.1.notes.2.text: Negative Stagger Thresholds are listed as in the source. Normal HP loss alone does not reach them; effects that move Stagger Thresholds are involved.

units.2.notes.0.text: A dangerous attacker with many attacks and Coin reuse. Has the lowest HP of the 3 and multiple Stagger Thresholds.

units.2.notes.1.text: Assist Attack does not function while Staggered. Stopping him early reduces both regular attacks and extra unopposed attacks.

phases.0.title.text: Stop Starbuck and preserve your defender

phases.0.steps.0.text: Focus strong attacks such as Pierce on Starbuck to reach his first Stagger Threshold. Win other dangerous Clashes and use Defense Skills to offset Evades where needed.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Damaging Ahab too quickly advances the second half. If unprepared, handle Starbuck and build resources first.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Save HP and SP on a Pierce-resistant defender for the coming focused attacks. Check E.G.O resources carried through the dungeon too.

phases.1.timing.text: To Me! / Track Them to the End!

phases.1.steps.0.text: The Sinner Clashing with Track Them to the End! receives focused attacks next turn. Assign a defender after checking Pierce resistance, Sin resistances, and HP.

phases.1.steps.1.text: The mark applies [On Use], while orders activate at Combat Start. Winning the Clash does not cancel next turn's mechanics.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Alternatively, Staggering Ahab on the order turn cancels it. In the first half, aim for her 60% HP Stagger Threshold, but avoid excessive damage: falling below 50% triggers the transition and healing.

phases.2.title.text: Protect your defender while fully depleting the Shield

phases.2.steps.0.text: Assist Defense redirects attacks aimed at Ahab to Queequeg, preventing Clashes with Ahab. Prepare Protection and healing for the marked Sinner.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Aim to fully deplete Queequeg's Assist Barrier that turn. Leaving it active prolongs assistance and makes Ahab harder to attack.

phases.2.steps.2.text: In the first half, depleting it can Stagger Queequeg next turn. If Starbuck remains, Stagger or defeat him to stop extra attacks too.

phases.3.timing.text: Ahab heals and enters the second half

phases.3.title.text: Watch negative-Coin skills and normal Stagger Thresholds

phases.3.steps.0.text: The crew mainly switches to negative-Coin attacks. Low enemy SP strengthens them, so do not reuse first-half Clash predictions.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Depleting Queequeg's Shield no longer causes Stagger through that effect. Consider reaching a normal HP Stagger Threshold on the order turn.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Staggering Ahab can also stop orders. Assistance already active may persist across the transition, so check the actual attack targets.

phases.3.steps.3.text: Once Starbuck is stopped and assistance handled, focus damage on defeating Ahab. You do not have to finish all enemies separately.

skills.0.effects.0.text: [On Use] Heal 10 SP for self and the other ally with the lowest SP.

skills.0.response.text: Offset Evade with a Defense Skill to land attacks. Unlike preventing hit effects, this does not necessarily cancel [On Use] SP healing.

skills.1.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Order Queequeg to use Assist Defense next turn. Cancel the order if Ahab becomes Staggered.

skills.1.response.text: Aim to Stagger Ahab this turn or prepare to deplete the next Shield. Offsetting alone cannot cancel the order.

skills.2.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Order Starbuck to use Assist Attack next turn. Cancel the order if Ahab becomes Staggered.

skills.2.effects.1.text: [On Use] Inflict 1 Prey Mark on the target next turn.

skills.2.response.text: Assign a durable Sinner. The mark applies even if you win, so account for next turn when choosing the opponent.

skills.3.response.text: Prevent Bleed with Clashes while possible. During assistance, use the marked defender's resistances and Protection against unopposed attacks.

skills.4.effects.0.text: Gain +1 Final Power per negative effect type on the main target, up to 5. Deal +5% damage per Bleed on the target.

skills.4.effects.2.text: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Inflict Burn equal to the target's Bleed value.

skills.4.response.text: Can exceed the listed 3–12. Targets carrying Bleed and debuffs increase both its power and damage.

skills.5.effects.1.text: [On Evade] Reduce the target's SP by 5.

skills.5.response.text: Offset with a Defense Skill before attacking. Avoid letting repeated Evades drain your main units' SP.

skills.6.effects.0.text: [On Use] Inflict 1 Prey Mark on the target next turn.

skills.6.effects.2.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Grant 4 Poise to 2 other allies. If no allies remain, gain 2 Poise Count instead.

skills.6.response.text: Applies the mark again. Choose someone who can survive the next focused attacks rather than considering only the current Clash odds.

skills.7.effects.0.text: [On Use] Heal 10 own SP and reduce the other ally with the highest SP by 10 SP.

skills.7.effects.1.text: Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[On Hit] Increase the target's Burn Count by 1 and inflict 1 Paralyze on one random other ally next turn.

skills.7.response.text: Ahab tends toward high SP while her crew falls to low SP. Include their negative-Coin skills when checking predictions.

skills.8.effects.0.text: [On Use] Grant Undefiable Command to the ally with the lowest SP.

skills.8.effects.1.text: [Clash Lose] Raise the Stagger Threshold of the ally with the lowest SP by 20.

skills.8.response.text: Win the Clash where possible to prevent Fragile on hit. During assistance, it becomes an unopposed attack.

skills.9.response.text: A normal Clash candidate. Prevent Bleed while building SP.

skills.10.effects.0.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Offense Level Down and 2 Bind next turn.

skills.10.response.text: Disrupts next turn's Clashes and redirection. Keep it away from main attackers.

skills.11.effects.2.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed. [On Crit] Raise the target's Stagger Threshold by 50% of damage dealt.

skills.11.response.text: Poise makes it more likely to push a target into Stagger. Consider stopping it with a strong skill or E.G.O.

skills.12.effects.0.text: Critical Hits do not consume Poise Count. Deal +5% damage per Bleed on the target.

skills.12.effects.1.text: [On Use] If this unit has no Poise, become Staggered at Turn End.

skills.12.effects.2.text: Ⅰ：Deal +50% damage on Critical Hit. [On Hit] Stagger the target next turn.

skills.12.response.text: A hit Staggers the target next turn even if HP remains. As an area attack, it is worth stopping with a reliable winner.

skills.13.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Gain 3 Poise and 5 Poise Count. Gain Final Power equal to own Poise Potency this turn; lose 1 Poise Count whenever damaged.

skills.13.response.text: The listed 8–9 excludes the Poise bonus. Use multiple hits to reduce Poise Count while depleting the Shield.

skills.14.effects.0.text: [Turn Start] If using this skill with Assist Barrier above 0, activate Assist Defense.

skills.14.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] Gain Assist Barrier equal to 10% of Max HP.

skills.14.response.text: This redirects attacks aimed at Ahab. Deplete the Shield or cause normal Stagger to stop assistance.

skills.15.effects.0.text: Gain +2 Final Power if attacking the same target as Starbuck.

skills.15.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Heal overall and Part HP by 50% of damage dealt.

skills.15.effects.2.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict Tangle and heal overall and Part HP by 50% of damage dealt.

skills.15.response.text: Combining Tangle with Capture causes Stagger. Low SP favors stronger Tails rolls, so check the enemy's SP too.

skills.16.effects.0.text: Critical Hits do not consume Poise Count. Deal +5% damage per Bleed on the target.

skills.16.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：Deal +50% damage on Critical Hit. [On Hit] Stagger the target next turn.

skills.16.response.text: Prolonged assistance leads to a dangerous area attack. Stop it with a Clash or prepare Stagger from the preceding turn.

skills.17.effects.1.text: Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 1.

skills.17.response.text: Extends Bleed applied by other enemies. Stagger him early to reduce attack count.

skills.18.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.

skills.18.effects.2.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down next turn. [Heads Hit] Reuse this Coin, up to 3 times.

skills.18.response.text: The listed 2 Coins exclude reuse. Letting it hit increases attacks and debuffs, so prioritize winning the Clash or Staggering him before he acts.

skills.19.effects.0.text: [Turn Start] If Queequeg's Assist Barrier is above 0, activate Assist Attack.

skills.19.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 1.

skills.19.response.text: An extra unopposed attack follows Ahab's attack. Limit damage by Staggering or defeating Starbuck, or by depleting the Shield.

skills.20.effects.0.text: Deal +50% damage on Critical Hit and +5% damage per Bleed on the target.

skills.20.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3. [On Crit] Raise the target's first Stagger Threshold by 50% of damage dealt.

skills.20.response.text: Bleed and Poise together cause heavy damage. Be especially careful if the marked defender is near Stagger.

skills.21.effects.1.text: Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 1.

skills.21.response.text: Tends to grow stronger at low SP. Prepare for the following critical attack too.

skills.22.effects.0.text: Gain +2 Final Power if attacking the same target as Queequeg.

skills.22.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict Capture. Inflict 5 Defense Level Down next turn.

skills.22.effects.2.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn. [Tails Hit] Reuse this Coin, up to 3 times.

skills.22.response.text: Combining Capture with Tangle causes Stagger, while reuse increases damage. Stop it with a strong Clash rather than treating it as only 2 hits.

skills.23.effects.0.text: Deal +100% damage on Critical Hit and +5% damage per Bleed on the target.

skills.23.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3. [On Crit] Raise the target's first Stagger Threshold by 50% of damage dealt.

skills.23.response.text: A negative-Coin attack with 20 Base Power. Low enemy SP does not weaken it; check predictions and resistances when answering it.

passives.0.effect.text: Increase Offense and Defense Levels by the number of other living allies.

passives.0.response.text: Defeating crew members reduces this buff as well as enemy actions.

passives.1.effect.text: Increase Offense and Defense Levels by the number of other living allies.

passives.1.response.text: Defeating crew members reduces this buff as well as enemy actions.

passives.2.effect.text: Increase Offense and Defense Levels by the number of other living allies.

passives.2.response.text: Defeating crew members reduces this buff as well as enemy actions.

passives.3.effect.text: At Turn Start, heal 15 SP unless at -45 SP. At Turn End, if in Panic, remove it and reset SP to 0.

passives.3.response.text: SP rises easily. In longer fights, prepare for high Heads odds.

passives.4.effect.text: Reset all other allies' SP to 0.

passives.4.response.text: Stagger also helps cancel orders, but low-SP negative-Coin attacks still need separate care.

passives.5.effect.text: Ahab heals. Captain's Orders stops activating for Queequeg and Starbuck.

passives.5.response.text: Her crew has less SP recovery and switches to negative-Coin skills. Adjust your first-half strategy.

passives.6.condition.text: Turn Start in the first half

passives.6.effect.text: Unless at -45 SP, heal SP equal to the number of other living allies × 5. If at -45 at Turn Start, remove Panic and reset SP to 0 at Turn End.

passives.6.response.text: Provides first-half SP recovery. Does not activate in the second half.

passives.7.response.text: Check SP after Stagger too. Previous high SP may not remain.

passives.8.condition.text: Turn Start in the first half

passives.8.effect.text: Unless at -45 SP, heal SP equal to the number of other living allies × 5. If at -45 at Turn Start, remove Panic and reset SP to 0 at Turn End.

passives.8.response.text: Provides first-half SP recovery. Does not activate in the second half.

passives.9.response.text: Check SP after Stagger too. Previous high SP may not remain.

passives.10.condition.text: An allied Pequod Town member is defeated

passives.10.response.text: Defeating Starbuck also reduces Poise, but second-half negative-Coin attacks grow stronger at low SP.

passives.11.response.text: If leaving her partially damaged, save answers to her attacks.

passives.12.effect.text: Recover to 50% of Max HP and gain 2 Attack Power Up next turn.

passives.12.response.text: Reaching 0 HP once does not finish her. The basic beginner strategy stops Starbuck first.

passives.13.effect.text: Increase the value of negative effects inflicted by skills by 1.

passives.13.response.text: Letting Poise attacks hit also means stronger debuffs.

passives.14.condition.text: Below 50% HP at Turn End / once per battle

passives.14.effect.text: Gain 2 Haste and 2 Attack Power Up next turn.

passives.14.response.text: After reducing HP by half, push on to Stagger or defeat rather than giving the buffed enemy a chance to retaliate.

passives.15.condition.text: Receives a Panic Type change effect

passives.15.effect.text: Panic Type stays unchanged; apply the effects intended for enemies without SP instead.

passives.15.response.text: Do not rely on changing Panic Type.

passives.16.condition.text: Receives a Panic Type change effect

passives.16.effect.text: Panic Type stays unchanged; apply the effects intended for enemies without SP instead.

passives.16.response.text: Do not rely on changing Panic Type.

passives.17.condition.text: Receives a Panic Type change effect

passives.17.effect.text: Panic Type stays unchanged; apply the effects intended for enemies without SP instead.

passives.17.response.text: Do not rely on changing Panic Type.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Prioritized by Pequod crew attacks and takes 50% more damage from them.

mechanics.0.response.text: Redirect the applying attack to a defender beforehand. Do not assume every attack can be redirected away afterward.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Attacks aimed at Ahab move to Queequeg's slots. The assisting unit's slot weight increases without limit.

mechanics.1.response.text: Area attacks aimed at Ahab may not land as expected either. Prioritize Staggering Queequeg or depleting her Shield.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Decreases by damage taken and persists across turns. In the first half, reaching 0 at Turn End causes Stagger next turn. This Stagger effect does not occur in the second half.

mechanics.2.response.text: Aim to fully deplete it in 1 turn. In the second half, pursue normal HP Stagger separately.

mechanics.3.effect.text: After Ahab's Attack Skill ends, Starbuck attacks the same target unopposed using his Counter skill's Coins, effects, and Offense Level.

mechanics.3.response.text: Do not calculate incoming damage from Ahab's attacks alone. This is one reason to stop Starbuck first.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Having both on the same target causes Stagger. Does not apply again to an already Staggered target.

mechanics.4.response.text: Avoid letting both second-half harpoon attacks hit the same Sinner. Stagger can occur even with plenty of HP.

mechanics.5.effect.text: On skill use, lose 10% of current HP and gain +1 Final Power. On hit, heal Ahab by 8 SP and grant both units 2 Poise.

mechanics.5.response.text: The user's attack is strengthened even while losing HP. Check second-half Clash predictions.

warnings.0.text: Unlike Ricardo's fight, Ishmael can be defeated normally here. Mandatory deployment does not mean invulnerability.

warnings.1.text: Assistance already active may persist into the second half. Advancing the phase does not guarantee removing it.

warnings.2.text: Stagger from depleting Queequeg's Shield differs from normal HP Stagger. The former does not occur in the second half.

warnings.3.text: Coin reuse is not included in the displayed count. Starbuck in particular gains extra attacks after hitting, making his Clashes valuable to stop.

preparation.0.text: Aim for Level 40 on your main units. Ishmael is mandatory, but you can prepare another Sinner as the defender.

preparation.1.text: Prepare a Pierce-resistant defender. Check Sin resistances to incoming attacks such as Gluttony, Pride, and Envy as well as HP.

preparation.2.text: Pierce works against Starbuck and Ahab; Blunt works against Queequeg. First secure winning skills, then exploit weaknesses among those options.

preparation.3.text: Prepare E.G.O resources within the dungeon for Protection, healing, or enemy Attack Power Down. No specific high-rarity Identity is required.

roles.0.reason.text: A Sinner with Pierce resistance and HP who can take the mark-applying attack. Support them with Protection and healing for next turn's focused attacks.

roles.1.reason.text: Aim for Stagger immediately to reduce Coin reuse and Assist Attack.

roles.2.reason.text: Set up Ahab's Stagger Threshold or focus Blunt and other damage on Queequeg. Shift roles between the order turn and the following assistance turn.
